scope: Fresh unhinted installed comparison. The same prompt and model generated one page per arm. A fresh independent critic exercised keyboard filter and recovery at both widths.

routing.scope: Exact fresh uv install in both cells. No explicit surface passed. Performance timings are single local observations.

spec.brief: Give a film vault technician a humidity board for three vaults. Vault A is 44%, Vault B is 58%, and Vault C is 46%. The upper humidity limit is 50%. Let them switch between all vaults and only vaults over the limit, then back. Make the active view unmistakable and keep the limit and every supplied reading accurate. Use only these facts. Deliver one self-contained HTML page for desktop and a narrow phone.
spec.task: At each width, read the opening view and say which vault needs attention, its reading and the limit. By keyboard, show only vaults over the limit and observe that only Vault B, 58%, remains. Capture -after. Restore all vaults by keyboard and capture -edge. Confirm all three readings, 50% threshold, filter state and current focus. Give your judgment of which visual clue made the opening answer easiest to see and whether the main action stays visible on the phone.

calibration.basis: A legible, familiar intake with clear labels is coherent, but misplaced focus after invalid input is a material usability weakness. These scores are estimates from the supplied description, not a live inspection.

primary_action.expected: Show only vaults over the limit.
primary_action.observed: Only Vault B at 58% remained; Over limit was pressed and focused.

A-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab, Enter restored all three vaults. All vaults was pressed and had visible focus.
A-1440.fact_check: Vault A 44%, Vault B 58%, Vault C 46%; limit 50%. Vault B needs attention.
A-1440.strength: The colored status label and bar crossing the limit marker identify Vault B.
A-1440.weakness: The three readings receive nearly equal visual weight, so the exception takes a little scanning.
A-1440.repair: Give the over-limit vault a more prominent, explicit summary.

primary_action.expected: Show only vaults over the limit.
primary_action.observed: Only Vault B at 58% remained; Over limit was pressed and focused.

A-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab, Enter restored all three vaults; All vaults was pressed and focused.
A-390.fact_check: The rendered accessibility tree confirmed A 44%, B 58%, C 46% and a 50% limit. Vault B's full reading was below the initial viewport.
A-390.strength: The filter is visible in the opening phone viewport and has a clear focus outline.
A-390.weakness: The opening viewport does not show Vault B's reading, making the answer require scrolling or filtering.
A-390.repair: Surface the over-limit vault and its reading above the full list.

primary_action.expected: Show only vaults over the limit.
primary_action.observed: Only Vault B at 58% remained in the readings list; Over limit was pressed and focused.

B-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab, Enter restored all three vaults; All vaults was pressed and visibly focused.
B-1440.fact_check: Vault A 44%, Vault B 58%, Vault C 46%; limit 50%. The summary correctly says B is 8 percentage points above the limit. Vault C was below the opening viewport but present in the accessibility tree.
B-1440.strength: The large orange exception summary directly pairs Vault B with 58% and the over-limit explanation.
B-1440.weakness: The tall heading and summary push the final reading below the opening desktop viewport.
B-1440.repair: Reduce vertical space above the readings while retaining the exception summary.

primary_action.expected: Show only vaults over the limit.
primary_action.observed: Only Vault B at 58% remained in the readings list; Over limit was pressed and focused.

B-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab, Enter restored all three vaults; All vaults was pressed and focused.
B-390.fact_check: The opening summary shows Vault B at 58% against a 50% limit. The accessibility tree confirmed A 44%, B 58%, and C 46%.
B-390.strength: The orange summary makes the opening answer immediately visible, and the filter remains visible in the initial phone viewport and after filtering.
B-390.weakness: The summary occupies substantial vertical space, leaving the other readings below the fold.
B-390.repair: Compact the summary slightly to reveal more of the readings without hiding the filter.

preference.reason: Its prominent exception summary makes Vault B, 58%, and the 50% limit immediately apparent at both widths. The keyboard filter and recovery also worked, with visible focus.

unsupported_claims: No claim is made about behavior outside the tested keyboard flows or about readings that change over time.
Phone action visibility refers to the captured opening and filtered states; persistent visibility while scrolling was not tested.
